messages:
sam_procurement: Heads up — our pool dropped to 6 A800s available after last week's failures. Need advice on topping up and how the vendor RMA will affect lead time. PO# RWI-2026-118.

irene_vendor: Sorry to hear that. We have 18 A800s in the EU allocation but 6 are flagged for depot repair (warranty). Can do 8 immediate air-topups from our buffer but there's a +22% expedite surcharge. ETA 4 days.

mira_ops: Can you confirm if the 8 are fresh units or refurbished returns? We need consistent performance for training clusters.

irene_vendor: Fresh units. Serial ranges from A8-2210 to A8-2217. We'll hold them pending your AWB/payment OK.

jordan_logistics: If we go air, can we use the carrier account on file? Also note customs clearance at FRA will add 6-12h unless we pre-file.

lena_customs: Pre-file recommended. I can run tariff classification under the telem clause to avoid delays but need HS code confirmation. Use 8471.80. Should also include invoice split: product value + warranty credit line.

sam_procurement: We want to avoid refurbished. Approve 8 fresh air units with expedite. Sam to sign PO amend. How will vendor handle returns for the 6 failed units?

irene_vendor: For the 6 failed, we'll issue RMA labels and forwarder pickup from our FRA depot. Option A: depot repair (replace cores and ship back) — RMA SLA 14 business days. Option B: cross-dock swap (send fresh units to you, you send DOA to forwarder) — immediate but requires pre-authorized AWB and acceptance of potential refurb return routing.

mira_ops: Cross-dock swap looks faster. Concern: our test bench needs serial traceability. Can we get manifest + preliminary test logs from your depot?

irene_vendor: Yes, we can attach depot test logs (burn-in minutes, power draw, firmware). We'll push a CSV. Example:
```
serial,unit_state,burn_in_min,power_w,fw
A8-2210,pass,120,650,2.1.0
A8-2211,pass,120,648,2.1.0
...
```

jordan_logistics: For cross-dock the paperwork must show conditional return — please include 'RMA pending inspection' on AWB. Carrier wants pickup slot window today 18:00-20:00 CET.

ops_oncall: Quick Q — if we accept cross-dock fresh units, what's the delta in our capacity minutes? We need to know when autoscaler can place jobs back.

mira_ops: If air arrives in 4 days and nodes rejoin within 2 hours of install, estimate +48 GPU-hours/day for immediate backlog. That covers the critical queues.

devops-bot: Incident note: cluster-prod-eu reported 6 A800 kernel panics since 3409860000. Autoscaler rebalanced jobs onto remaining GPUs — cost +14% this billing window.

sam_procurement: OK proceeding with 8 fresh air A800s via vendor buffer, cross-dock swap for RMA returns, pre-file customs (8471.80), use carrier acct, approve PO amend for +22% expedite surcharge. Jordan: confirm pickup slot and AWB create. Irene: please attach the CSV test logs and RMA labels.

irene_vendor: Copy that. Creating AWB now, will upload manifest and RMA labels to the shared link. AWB: 1ZABC1234567890EU (placeholder). ETA 4 days. Pickup slot requested.

jordan_logistics: Slot confirmed 19:00 CET today for pickup of outgoing RMA paperwork only; actual dispatch on vendor pickup 48h. I'll create pre-file with customs and flag the AWB reference.

lena_customs: I'll pre-file with FRA and set clearance code expedited. Send invoice split and PO amend when ready.

mira_ops: Post-delivery step: bench test 30m per GPU, then tag in inventory and mark for autoscaler. I'll create a short runbook for the floor techs.

sam_procurement: Thanks all. Action items: sam to sign PO amend; irene to upload manifest & RMA labels; jordan to finalize AWB and carrier; lena to pre-file customs. We'll reconvene if any hold occurs. :thumbsup:
